### Lumo by Proton

An [AI assistant][169] where every conversation is actually confidential.

[Start a chat][170][Explore Lumo
][171]

## Protect your business with easy-to-use encrypted solutions.

[Proton]

### Proton for Business

Proton secures more than 100,000 businesses including some of the world’s largest public and private
organizations.

[Get Proton for Business][172][Explore
][173]

## With Proton, your data belongs to you, not tech companies, governments, or hackers.

[Get your encrypted email][174]

### Fundamentally different

Proton was started in 2014 by scientists who met at CERN and shared a vision of an internet that
defends freedom and puts people first.

Our transparency, open-source software, and rigorous encryption have earned Proton millions of users
— and the recommendation of the United Nations.

Tech companies like Google or Apple define privacy as “nobody can exploit your data, except for us.”
We believe nobody should exploit your data, period.

Our technology and business are based upon this fundamentally stronger definition of privacy, backed
also by Swiss privacy laws.

### Privacy for a better world

At Proton, we believe that a better world begins with privacy, and this is at the heart of
everything we do. Privacy isn’t just something we talk about; it’s a core belief and the reason
Proton was created in the first place.

We also believe in people before profits, and our primary shareholder is the nonprofit [Proton
Foundation][175], whose mission is to fight for an open internet that promotes freedom of speech and
freedom of information.

[Learn about our impact][176]
[Proton Mail]

## Over 100 million people and businesses have signed up for Proton

[Join Proton][177][Proton for Business][178]

### End-to-end encryption

Our end-to-end encryption and zero-access encryption mean that no one (not even Proton) has the
technical means to access your data without your permission.

We don’t sell ads and can’t share your data. At Proton, privacy isn’t a promise, it’s mathematically
ensured.

[Discover Proton’s encryption
][179]

### Swiss privacy

Proton is based in Switzerland, and your data does not go to the cloud. Instead, it stays under the
protection of some of the world’s strongest privacy laws.

We are a neutral and safe haven for your personal data, committed to defending your freedom.

[About Swiss privacy
][180]

### Switching made easy

Proton’s services are so simple and intuitive that anyone can use them. Move your emails, contacts,
and calendars from Google, Outlook, and other providers to Proton in just a few clicks.

Connect your Gmail to Proton Mail to read, send and receive your emails in one place, bringing you
one step closer to leaving behind Big Tech for good.

[Connect your Gmail account
][181]

### Open source and audited

Since we were founded by scientists, we know that trust is earned through transparency and peer
review.

All our apps are open source and independently audited by security experts so that anyone can
inspect them, use them, and trust them.

[Proton and open source
][182]

### One account, any device

Access your email, files, calendars, passwords, and VPN anywhere.

Get Proton apps on all your devices (Android, iPhone and iPad, Windows, macOS, Linux, and more) with
one Proton Account for all our privacy-by-default services.

[See all Proton services
][183]

### Free forever

Privacy is a human right, so our services are always available for free, and our encryption tech is
free as well.

Proton has no ads and does not sell your data. You can support the service by upgrading to a paid
account with more features.

[Get a free Proton account
][184]

## Our story begins at CERN, where the web was born

View details

Proton was founded in 2014 by scientists who met at the European Organization for Nuclear Research
(CERN) and shared a vision for a more secure and private internet. We believe in technical
excellence, integrity, and transparency.

Proton is led by scientists, including Sir Tim Berners-Lee, the inventor of the World Wide Web, and
we work for the public good.

[Read our story
][185]

## Built by the community, for the community

View details

Proton is a community-first organization, created through a public crowdfunding campaign and built
with community input. Our only source of revenue is subscriptions from users.

We exist only to serve you, not advertisers or other third parties. By choosing Proton, you join a
movement of millions of volunteers, contributors, and users creating an internet that puts people
first.

[Join our community
][186]

## Choose an internet where your privacy comes first

One account for all Proton services.

[Create a free account][187]

# Welcome to the RIPE NCC

As the Regional Internet Registry for Europe, Middle East and Central Asia, we serve over 20,000
members in 76 countries. We register IP addresses and ASNs, and act as the secretariat to the RIPE
community.

[About the RIPE NCC][332] [LIR Portal][333]

[RIPE NCC Strategy 2027-31 Published][336]

The RIPE NCC Strategy 2027-31 is now available. This strategy builds upon our existing vision,
mission and values and sets the long-term direction for the organisation. The document explains RIPE
NCC’s role in the Internet ecosystem, sets out six strategic focus areas for the coming five-year
period and the external factors that influence our operating environment.

# Welcome to the RIPE NCC

As the Regional Internet Registry for Europe, Middle East and Central Asia, we serve over 20,000
members in 76 countries. We register IP addresses and ASNs, and act as the secretariat to the RIPE
community.

### We serve many of the world's largest companies, law firms, and other institutions - working with
### them to monetize IP, defend IP litigations, and provide intelligence so they lead innovation in
### their industry and achieve the most out of their IP budgets.

We work with **the World’s largest companies** – helping them to lead innovation in their industries
– and **with smaller ones,** to run a successful, corporate-grade IP division within their budgets.
We support **IP law firms** with critical technology research, paralegal services & tools to provide
their clients with a globally optimized solution. We help **patent owners** manage, maintain and
monetize their IP. We partner with **government and non-government institutions** in promoting and
commercializing innovation.

Currently being one of the largest providers of IP research services globally and by serving the
global IP community for over a decade, we have developed knowledge, best practices, **IP Tech/AI
tools and analytical frameworks** – on a variety of topics pertaining to the IP space, through our
team of **experts located in 9 offices across the globe**.

### them to monetize IP, defend IP litigations, and provide intelligence so they lead innovation in

We work with **the World’s largest companies** – helping them to lead innovation in their industries
– and **with smaller ones,** to run a successful, corporate-grade IP division within their budgets.
We support **IP law firms** with critical technology research, paralegal services & tools to provide
their clients with a globally optimized solution. We help **patent owners** manage, maintain and
monetize their IP. We partner with **government and non-government institutions** in promoting and
commercializing innovation.

Currently being one of the largest providers of IP research services globally and by serving the
global IP community for over a decade, we have developed knowledge, best practices, **IP Tech/AI
tools and analytical frameworks** – on a variety of topics pertaining to the IP space, through our
team of **experts located in 9 offices across the globe**.

# Welcome to Tidman Legal

## Intellectual Property Solicitors

As Intellectual Property Solicitors, Tidman Legal aims to make the process of obtaining intellectual
property rights as smooth as possible for your business. [Intellectual property][44] is an essential
part of all business. If you have ambitions to succeed in business you need to understand what your
most important asset is to properly protect and exploit it.


## BUSINESS SERVICES

## COPYRIGHT SERVICES

## TRADEMARK SERVICES

## DESIGN RIGHTS SERVICES

## PATENT SERVICES

## IP AUDIT SERVICES

###### – MORE SERVICES –

## What is Intellectual Property?

Intellectual Property (IP) is often the single most valuable asset of any business. IP is the
collective name for the rights that protect creativity, ideas and innovation. It is very wide. All
businesses have IP issues to consider because every business has a name, a logo, a website, a
database of contacts and more besides. These are all intangible assets that are important to the
success of a business. Despite this, IP is widely misunderstood and frequently unprotected and
under-exploited.

Strategic decisions about IP should be made early in the business so as to make good choices of IP
and determine how best to protect yourself with your available resources.

[Read more about Intellectual Property…][45]

[View our IP Services][46]

[tidman-icon-blue]

## How can we help you?

It is important to seek professional advice from Intellectual Property Solicitors in relation to
your IP before implementing your idea. IP law is complex, and the business, financial and legal
issues around it are difficult to navigate. By consulting an IP lawyer at an early stage you are
much better placed to make effective choices and reduce the likelihood of costly mistakes later on.

We are well placed to help you take control of your intellectual property so your business can
flourish from a secure foundation. Do get in touch for a no obligation confidential discussion and
we will tell you how we can help.

#### [More about how we can help...][47]

We offer a complimentary introductory consultation at which your business needs and options are
considered. This provides an opportunity for us to understand your business and needs, as well as to
identify ways to best protect your ideas and discuss any areas where additional protection is
required. If you already have a portfolio of IP, we also offer a regular meeting so we can discuss
developments to your products, services and business. We often act like in-house counsel to get a
real feel for your business and advise accordingly.

If you need a lawyer, we are available to help. We put ourselves at your service to meet your
business requirements and we aim to provide excellence in everything we do. We are on the phone,
e-mail and Skype. We love to chat.

[Arrange a meeting][48]

[keyboard]

## Startup Packages

Tidman Legal offers a range of fixed price start-up packages based on your particular business
situation and requirements. From securing vital intellectual property protection to ensuring your
business is legally prepared to go online, we have a suitable package for you.

[View our startup packages][49]

# Welcome to Tidman Legal

## Intellectual Property Solicitors

As Intellectual Property Solicitors, Tidman Legal aims to make the process of obtaining intellectual
property rights as smooth as possible for your business. [Intellectual property][44] is an essential
part of all business. If you have ambitions to succeed in business you need to understand what your
most important asset is to properly protect and exploit it.


## BUSINESS SERVICES

## COPYRIGHT SERVICES

## TRADEMARK SERVICES

## DESIGN RIGHTS SERVICES

## PATENT SERVICES

## IP AUDIT SERVICES

###### – MORE SERVICES –

## What is Intellectual Property?

Intellectual Property (IP) is often the single most valuable asset of any business. IP is the
collective name for the rights that protect creativity, ideas and innovation. It is very wide. All
businesses have IP issues to consider because every business has a name, a logo, a website, a
database of contacts and more besides. These are all intangible assets that are important to the
success of a business. Despite this, IP is widely misunderstood and frequently unprotected and
under-exploited.

Strategic decisions about IP should be made early in the business so as to make good choices of IP
and determine how best to protect yourself with your available resources.

[Read more about Intellectual Property…][45]

[View our IP Services][46]

[tidman-icon-blue]

## How can we help you?

It is important to seek professional advice from Intellectual Property Solicitors in relation to
your IP before implementing your idea. IP law is complex, and the business, financial and legal
issues around it are difficult to navigate. By consulting an IP lawyer at an early stage you are
much better placed to make effective choices and reduce the likelihood of costly mistakes later on.

We are well placed to help you take control of your intellectual property so your business can
flourish from a secure foundation. Do get in touch for a no obligation confidential discussion and
we will tell you how we can help.

#### [More about how we can help...][47]

We offer a complimentary introductory consultation at which your business needs and options are
considered. This provides an opportunity for us to understand your business and needs, as well as to
identify ways to best protect your ideas and discuss any areas where additional protection is
required. If you already have a portfolio of IP, we also offer a regular meeting so we can discuss
developments to your products, services and business. We often act like in-house counsel to get a
real feel for your business and advise accordingly.

If you need a lawyer, we are available to help. We put ourselves at your service to meet your
business requirements and we aim to provide excellence in everything we do. We are on the phone,
e-mail and Skype. We love to chat.

[Arrange a meeting][48]

[keyboard]

## Startup Packages

Tidman Legal offers a range of fixed price start-up packages based on your particular business
situation and requirements. From securing vital intellectual property protection to ensuring your
business is legally prepared to go online, we have a suitable package for you.

[View our startup packages][49]

Do you keep missing deadlines and appointments because you recorded the wrong dates? Perhaps, it’s

## **Free Printable Calendars 202**6

Do you keep missing deadlines and appointments because you recorded the wrong dates? Perhaps, it’s
because you don’t have a reliable calendar. While phone calendars and online date trackers are more
commonly used nowadays, printable calendars still offer a better solution. No need to turn on your
phone. No need to check your meetings online. With just a quick glance, you can immediately know
what date it is or what day of the week you are in. Simple, right?

Start January with fireworks. Celebrate love in February. Create memorable holidays in December. No

US-sized paper. Add colors, stickers, creative fonts, and other attractive designs to personalize
your monthly printable calendar.

Forget online schedulers. Personalization is what you need, and our printable calendars will give

**Free Downloadable Calendars**

Yes, all our printable calendars are free! No upfront fee. No subscription payment. Nothing. Just
click on the monthly calendar you need and you’ll get free access to download it. No strings
attached. Save it on your phone, tablet, laptop, or desktop computer at work—the decision is yours.
Then, print it on your preferred paper type so you can use it at home, in the classroom, or your
office.

**Blank Calendar Templates**

For creative minds and artistic hands, blank calendar templates are an excellent choice. Feel free
to add attractive fonts, colorful numbers, and other decorative symbols and icons you want. Your
blank calendar will serve as your canvas in creating a masterpiece that not only tells you the exact
dates but also keeps you organized with your daily schedules.

**Year Round Tracking**

Life can be busy, and tracking everything that you need to do can be challenging if you don’t have a
reliable calendar for each month. That’s where our monthly printable calendars come in. From January
to December, you can easily organize your schedules, track your appointments, and celebrate special
occasions.

**Personalize Your Calendars**

Not everyone likes the same calendar designs, so we’re offering personalization just the way you
like it. Style our printable calendar according to your favorite color, flower, emojis, or simply
anything that matches your personality. You can even create different designs for different months.
Cool, eh? That’s how we do it here in Type Calendar.

This ensures that you won’t feel confused when checking your calendar. You can commence school,
work, and other appointments just as you have scheduled. There’s no superior method to stay
organized and manage your meetings than a professionally crafted printable calendar from Type
Calendar!

## **PRINTABLE CALENDAR WITH HOLIDAYS**

Holidays are fun for many reasons. For one, there’s no work or school. It’s a time to meet with
friends or do some personal errands. Shopping. Dining out. Staying at home. Celebrate with family.
And the list goes on! These are just the common things we do during holidays. But make sure that
everything is well planned out. Our printable calendar features a simple but professional design.
The ample white spaces allow you to add little notes and details about upcoming holidays and special
occasions.

STEP 1: Choose your month.

STEP 2: Pick out a preferred template.

STEP 3: Click the DOWNLOAD CALENDAR button.

STEP 4: Save your calendar in your drive.

STEP 5: Personalize your calendar.

STEP 6: Print.

ezen célból tárolt vagy lekért információk általában nem használhatók fel azonosításra.

page also tracks what this means for imports and climate pressure, from 100% crude oil import
dependency and 96.7% coal import dependency to 2023 CO2 emissions of 435 MtCO2 and an intensity of
505 gCO2 per kWh.
